scripts.test:webhooks: playwright test; code=$?; node scripts/upload-test-results.js; node scripts/generate-coverage-report.js; exit $code
scripts.test:staging: APP_ENV=staging-us bash -c 'playwright test; code=$?; node scripts/generate-coverage-report.js; exit $code'
scripts.test:prod:eu: APP_ENV=prod-eu CONFIRM_PROD=yes bash -c 'playwright test; code=$?; node scripts/generate-coverage-report.js; exit $code'
scripts.test:prod:us: APP_ENV=prod-us CONFIRM_PROD=yes bash -c 'playwright test; code=$?; node scripts/generate-coverage-report.js; exit $code'
scripts.test:prod:in: APP_ENV=prod-in CONFIRM_PROD=yes bash -c 'playwright test; code=$?; node scripts/generate-coverage-report.js; exit $code'
